<div class="sheet">

      <h1>Single Agent or Many? Scoping Decision Matrix</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A one-page scoping verdict with the reasoning recorded, and over time a locally calibrated file-count threshold replacing the book's 10-15 default.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-17-single-vs-multi-agent-decision-matrix</b><br>
      Pack D &middot; fill order 9<br>
      type <b>decision</b> &middot; audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Multi-Agent Orchestration</b> &middot; &ldquo;When One Agent Is Enough&rdquo; &middot;
    <code>handbook/ch17-multi-agent-orchestration.qmd</code> L16-45 &middot;

    &middot; fill after <b>WS-17-coordination-tax-calculator</b>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill this in <b>before any agent is dispatched</b>; a verdict written afterwards is a justification, not a decision.
    For the change in front of you, write the actual value for each of the six dimensions, say which way it points, and say how sure you are of it.
    Then tick the seven criteria, record the verdict and the reason. The grey italic columns are the book's starting values; once block D (sheet 4) is set, score against column 4 instead.
  </div>

          <td class="prior">Fewer than 10 files in a single module.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L20</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="locked"><i>Sufficient when:</i> Concern is singular</td>
          <td class="prior">One type of change, not three interleaved concerns.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L21</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="locked"><i>Sufficient when:</i> Dependencies are linear</td>
          <td class="prior">Each file change follows naturally from the previous one, with no need for parallel work.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L22</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="locked"><i>Sufficient when:</i> Context budget is adequate</td>
          <td class="prior">The agent can hold all relevant source files, instructions and conversation history without exceeding roughly 60% of its window capacity, leaving room for reasoning.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L23</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="locked"><i>Breaks down when:</i> Multiple concerns intersect</td>
          <td class="prior">Architectural knowledge and domain expertise and security awareness at once; one agent cannot hold three specialisation contexts without dilution.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L27</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="locked"><i>Breaks down when:</i> File count exceeds context capacity</td>
          <td class="prior">More than 15-20 files and the agent cannot see all the code it needs to modify.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L28</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>

        <tr>
          <td class="locked"><i>Breaks down when:</i> Parallelism would reduce wall-clock time significantly</td>
          <td class="prior">Five independent file groups that could be modified simultaneously instead take five times as long sequentially.<span class="prior-src">ch17 L29</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><div class="f-select"><span class="opt">Yes</span><span class="opt">Partial</span><span class="opt">No</span></div></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text sm"></span></td>
        </tr>
